qualifier: telomerase extension and C-strand fill-in synthesis
name: Telomere lengthening by telomerase and C-strand synthesis
rationale: All members concern telomere maintenance, and the theme uniquely carries telomerase extension, telomerase holoenzyme assembly and C-strand fill-in steps, whereas confusables centre on recombination-based maintenance, capping and NHEJ protection.

name: Endosomal TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9 signaling
rationale: Every member concerns signaling by the endosomal nucleic-acid-sensing TLR7/8/9 (including SLC15A4:TASL-IRF5 activation), while confusables are cytosolic RIG-I/cGAS-STING type I interferon pathways.

core: Cellular response to drugs and stress
name: Cellular response to anesthetics, ethanol and other drugs
rationale: Most members are responses to chemicals (ethanol, ether, anesthetic, antibiotic, drug) or oxidative/hypoxic stress, and the anesthetic, ether and ethanol responses are what neighbours lacking them do not have; amine metabolism and developmental apoptosis fit only loosely.

qualifier: B cell activation and its negative regulation
name: B cell receptor signaling and its regulation
rationale: Members are BCR signaling events (second messengers, RAS, BTK, CD22 regulation) plus B cell proliferation and differentiation and an activation-brake module, distinguishing it from T cell receptor and B cell development neighbours.

name: Peptide, histidine and heme membrane transport
rationale: All members are transmembrane transport, specifically proton-coupled oligopeptide/histidine transport and heme/iron assimilation at host-pathogen membranes, which separates it from iron-homeostasis and neutral amino acid transport neighbours.

name: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting control
rationale: Members regulate axon growth, regeneration and sprouting (RHOA growth inhibition, ceramide signalling, collateral sprouting), unlike neighbours focused on p75NTR death signaling, Sema3A guidance or myelination.

name: Paracellular magnesium transport via tight junctions
rationale: Members combine magnesium transport and homeostasis with tight junction, claudin-type calcium-independent adhesion and paracellular transport, which no confusable shares.

qualifier: electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis rather than complex assembly
name: Respiratory electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
rationale: All members are the catalytic steps of the respiratory chain and ATP formation, while every confusable concerns assembly of respiratory complexes and mitochondrial translation.

name: Integrin–Rap1 signaling and endothelial shear stress response
rationale: Members share integrin activation, Rap1 and integrin-to-MAPK signaling in platelets and adhesion, and uniquely include PIEZO1/integrin responses to laminar and oscillatory shear stress in endothelium.

qualifier: atypical ubiquitin linkages and misfolded protein quality control
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members span ubiquitin chain formation (K6/K11/K27/K29, branched), degron-based proteasomal degradation, ERAD and misfolded protein quality control, distinguishing it from deubiquitinase, aggrephagy and proteasome assembly neighbours.

name: Axon guidance by netrin, ephrin and L1-family cues
rationale: All members are axon guidance signaling, and the theme carries ephrin, L1/CHL1, DSCAM and netrin/DCC pathways that neighbours focused on SLIT/ROBO commissural pathfinding or dendrite self-avoidance lack.

qualifier: collagen, basement membrane and elastic fibers
name: Collagen, basement membrane and elastic fiber assembly
rationale: Members build and organize the extracellular matrix (collagen synthesis and crosslinking, laminin/basement membrane, elastic fibres, hemidesmosomes, integrin binding), in contrast to neighbours on matrix degradation, cornified envelope or myogenesis.

qualifier: germinal center and T follicular helper differentiation
name: B cell activation with germinal center and Tfh differentiation
rationale: Members regulate B cell proliferation and differentiation, and uniquely add germinal center B cell and T follicular helper differentiation with ICOS costimulation, which CD27/memory B cell neighbours lack.

qualifier: apoptotic nuclear dismantling and necroptosis control
name: Apoptotic nuclear dismantling and necroptosis regulation
rationale: Members are the execution phase of apoptosis (DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation, lamina breakdown) plus regulation of necroptosis, unlike neighbours on extrinsic, mitochondrial intrinsic or RIPK1 necroptotic signaling.

qualifier: carboxylates, carnitine and inherited transporter defects
name: Carboxylate and carnitine transport and inherited transporter defects
rationale: Members are solute carrier transport of carboxylates, pyruvate, monocarboxylates, carnitine and related metabolites with their transporter deficiency diseases, distinguishing it from organic cation and cationic amino acid transport neighbours.

name: FLT3 mutant signaling and kinase inhibitor resistance
rationale: Every member concerns FLT3 signaling, its CBL-mediated negative regulation or TKI-resistant FLT3 mutants, separating it from KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR mutant neighbours.

qualifier: unwinding and polymerase activity in dividing cells
name: Replicative DNA unwinding and synthesis in dividing cells
rationale: Members concern DNA unwinding, polymerase activation and replication in the mitotic cycle, including break-induced replication, whereas neighbours center on telomere recombination, replication initiation control or DNA repair.

qualifier: T cell polarity with CD28–Vav1 signaling
name: T cell immunological synapse and polarity via CD28–Vav1
rationale: Members describe immunological synapse formation, T cell polarity, raft localization and lymphocyte aggregation, and the CD28-Vav1 and Nef signaling members are what neighbours with CORO1A-DEF6 networks lack.

name: Polyamine metabolism and methionine salvage
rationale: Members cover synthesis, oxidation and interconversion of putrescine, spermidine and spermine linked to methionine salvage from methylthioadenosine, which neighbours focused on ODC regulation, polyamine transport and hypusine lack.

qualifier: receptor signaling and glucose uptake in target tissues
name: Insulin receptor signaling and GLUT4 glucose uptake
rationale: Members concern insulin receptor signaling, IRS/AKT2 activation, GLUT4 translocation, glucose import and glycogen synthesis, separating it from neighbours about beta-cell insulin secretion or muscle activity.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling in skeletal muscle
rationale: Members regulate SR/ER calcium uptake and ryanodine receptor release in striated muscle, with skeletal contraction and fibre-type transition, whereas neighbours center on cardiac contraction, conduction and store-operated entry.

name: Cornified envelope and epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members describe keratinocyte development, cornified envelope assembly and skin barrier establishment, unlike neighbours on epidermal lipid metabolism or keratinocyte proliferation control.

name: Aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy
rationale: Members concern aggresome formation, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and endosomal microautophagy, with the regulation of chaperone-mediated autophagy distinguishing it from ubiquitin-proteasome and stress granule neighbours.

name: Osteoblast and osteoclast regulation in bone remodeling
rationale: All members regulate osteoblast or osteoclast proliferation, differentiation and bone resorption, while neighbours concern bone mineralization and IGF responses.

name: Methionine cycle, choline and carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members cover methionine/SAM metabolism, salvage and inherited defects plus choline catabolism and carnitine synthesis, which neighbours focused on cobalamin, folate and other vitamins lack.
